parts:

messages.author: d34d025a513c07fc
messages.subject: Re: colours(), link to colour-table
parts:
Perhaps you're thinking of this?
http://research.stowers-institute.org/efg/R/Color/Chart/

I personally don't like those numbered colors, though, because they're not organized in a useful way.. Outside of the basic names like "red", "blue", etc., the color names aren't very useful either.

I find it much more useful to use RGB numbers or colors from RColorBrewer:
http://wiki.stdout.org/rcookbook/Graphs/Colors%20%28ggplot2%29#Color_charts

-Winston
